decisions.reason: The reporting dimensions and conversion metric do not change the deferred direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization requirement.
The source specifies HubSpot funnel reporting content but does not change how leads are transferred from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
The requested Contact Source funnel and Contacts-to-Leads metric do not alter the MeetAlfred campaign creation or Zap setup workflow.
The HubSpot reporting specification is unrelated to provisioning the outreach campaign domain.
